senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sung, chaunted, sounded, &c.
f. (-ता)
A name often applied to books, as the Śiva Gītā, Rāma Gītā, Gītā Govinda, Bhagavad Gītā, which last is also often called Gītā only.
n. (-तं)
Singing, song either general or particular.
E.
गॄ to sing, affix क्त.

m. (-दी)
A Kinnara or celestial chorister.
E.
गीत song or singing, and मोदिन् who delights.

f. (-तिः)
1 Song, singing.
2 A kind of poetical metre, a form of the Ārya metre, in which the stanza consists of four lines of twelve and eighteen syllabic instants alternately.
E.
गै to sing, affix क्तिन्.
